senses.gloss: to take up a large amount of time, energy, or attention
senses.example: Preparing the annual report consumed most of her afternoon.

translations.th_TH: กินเวลา; ใช้

example_translations.zh_TW: 準備年度報告耗去了她下午的大半時間。

example_translations.ko_KR: 연례 보고서를 준비하느라 그녀는 오후의 대부분을 썼습니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Việc chuẩn bị báo cáo thường niên đã chiếm gần hết buổi chiều của cô ấy.
example_translations.th_TH: การเตรียมรายงานประจำปีใช้เวลาเกือบทั้งบ่ายของเธอ
